title: Sales/CS enterprise wishlist triage and quick econ story
creator: Noah Kim
description: Create a repeatable, lightweight process for Sales and CS to aggregate enterprise feature requests (non-bug) and produce a one-page scoping + economic snapshot that enables PMs and Eng to make a fast go/no-go decision. The goal is to reduce discovery latency for high-touch customers while ensuring we capture technical constraints, compliance signals, and a defensible cost/benefit range before committing engineering cycles.
acceptance_criteria: A one-page intake template (Google Doc) that Sales/CS can fill in under 30 minutes
A 4-point prioritization thermometer (customer econ, usage fit, implementation risk, strategic alignment) with scoring guidance
An implementation-readiness rubric that yields one of: No-go, Quick Spike, Scoped MVP, or Backlog
A clear handoff checklist for PMs and Eng with mandatory links (sample prompt set, security/data notes, customer success contact)
At least two pilot accounts complete intake using the template and provide feedback
tasks: Draft intake template and thermometer (owner: Priya)
Align rubric with Solutions Engineering and Legal (owner: Noah)
Build quick econ proxy ranges for common ask types (owner: PM analyst)
Pilot template with 2 CS reps and refine (owner: Solutions Eng lead)
Add intake form to Sales toolkit and create a one-click Confluence link (owner: Docs)
Create a minimal tracking dashboard (owner: Analytics)
Document follow-up workflows for Scoped MVP vs Quick Spike outcomes

2026-03-07 Legal (R. Chen): Quick review flagged SCIM/KMS integration as a required field for any request that touches customer-managed keys. Marked as blocker for private-deployment asks.

2026-03-09 Priya Desai: Ran pilot with Account A and Account B; both completed intake in ~22 minutes. Feedback: econ proxy ranges unclear for multi-tenant vs dedicated capacity. Added guidance for both scenarios.
2026-03-10 Noah Kim: Updated acceptance criteria and scheduled stakeholder review on 2026-03-12. Analytics to add a minimal tracking sheet for outcomes (No-go/Spike/MVP/Backlog).
decision_log: 2026-03-03: Decision to prioritize speed of Sales/CS completion over exhaustive technical detail; technical signals captured via mandatory checkboxes and follow-up tasks.
2026-03-05: Include explicit compliance/data residency checkbox following Solutions Eng request.
2026-03-07: Legal requires KMS/SCIM note for Private deployment asks; these will escalate to Security review if marked.
2026-03-09: Use econ proxy bands (low/medium/high) with examples instead of exact cost estimates to avoid false precision during intake.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Sales fills template incompletely to move deals forward — Mitigation: require CS rep attestation and attach customer contact; track incomplete submissions in dashboard.
Risk: Early econ proxy is mistaken causing PMs to deprioritize — Mitigation: label proxied ranges clearly and require follow-up sizing spike for high-impact asks.
Risk: Sensitive compliance details missed — Mitigation: escalate any 'private deployment' checkboxes to Security within 24 hours; blocker until sign-off.
Risk: Duplicate asks across accounts — Mitigation: intake includes feature tags and account cohort to allow deduplication in triage meetings
